pass.answer: `claude plugin configure` has no scope flag: it finds only an install visible from the working directory, so a project or local install is found only from that project. For the install `--config` rerun, pass the scope `claude plugin list` reports for markdown-format, because a rerun at another scope adds an install record at that scope and enables the plugin there. From the home directory that list can show one file as both `user` and `project`; pass `user`.
